strategy_log.diagnosis: M2 head-ref gate (if: startsWith(github.head_ref, "appfactory/fix-")) applied to the shared build job, which also serves the workflow_dispatch baseline. On dispatch, head_ref is empty so the gate is false: the baseline build job is skipped, the run concludes "skipped" with an empty log, and isSuccess("")==true makes the fix loop short-circuit before any LLM call — "no non-.github changes; no PR". Root cause was a fix (fbbaf62 M2) that regressed an earlier fix (M1 baseline).
strategy_log.strategy_chosen: event-aware gate: exempt workflow_dispatch from the head-ref guard (github.event_name == "workflow_dispatch" || startsWith(...)); add test asserting the exemption
strategy_alternatives_considered: split into two jobs (baseline + PR-head) with separate triggers
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: Minimal change preserving both behaviors (baseline always builds, only fix-PR heads build); single job keeps concurrency/CI simple; test locks the regression
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: run 31058262819 skipped (empty log, llm_calls=0, no PR) → run 31072289513 Build step failed with real log, LLM called once, PR #2 opened (main.go only, M2 check-run success); all tests green
strategy_log.followup: None for this bug; remaining: marketplace install-permissions screenshot (auth), launch gates

opencode_web_termux.summary: opencode_web crashed on Termux/proot: hardcoded Alpine paths + no browser
opencode_web_termux.detail: Root cause: browser.py hardcoded NODE_PATH='/usr/local/lib/node_modules', executable_path='/usr/bin/chromium', BROWSERS_PATH default '/home/.cache/ms-playwright'. On Termux/proot-distro Ubuntu none of these exist. Playwright launches and throws 'Failed to launch chromium because executable doesn't exist at /usr/bin/chromium'. Fix: added env-aware resolution (_resolve_node_path, _resolve_browsers_path, _resolve_chromium_executable, _find_playwright_browser). Browser() now auto-detects Chromium via $PREFIX/bin/chromium (Termux), /usr/bin/chromium-browser, PATH, or falls back to a Playwright-managed browser. backend/browser.js now omits executablePath when none provided. Clear actionable error raised when no browser exists.

cdp_skills_integration.summary: Integrated two zero-dependency Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) skills for OpenCode
cdp_skills_integration.detail:
Cloned and installed two CDP skills into ~/.config/opencode/skills/skills/:
1. faster-chrome-devtools-skill (zeke) — Node 22+ built-in WebSocket CLI (cdp.mjs); connects to a running Chrome via CDP_HTTP_ENDPOINT/CDP_WS_ENDPOINT; commands list/open/snapshot/screenshot/navigate/evaluate/click/fill/type/press.
2. cdp-skill (lotreace) — JSON step pipeline CLI (cdp-skill.js); newTab/snapshot/click/fill/type/hover/drag/evaluate/screenshot; auto-launches Chrome.
Both avoid Playwright's Chromium-download crash on Termux. Patched lotreace's findChromePath() to be Termux/Playwright-aware (honors OPCODE_WEB_CHROMIUM, $PREFIX/bin/chromium, Playwright-managed chromium), matching the opencode_web fix. Verified end-to-end against a headless Playwright chromium on port 9222.
